description: Source code for the 'shell_mgmt' group in MCUmgr, implementing command execution and management handlers for shell commands over SMP protocol.

methods.name: shell_exec
methods.description: Executes a shell command line received as input.

methods.name: shell_get_output
methods.description: Retrieves the output of the last executed shell command.

methods.name: shell_mgmt_exec
methods.description: Handles the 'exec' command in the MCUmgr shell management group, decoding input, executing shell commands, and encoding output.

methods.name: shell_mgmt_translate_error_code
methods.description: Translates shell management error codes into MCUmgr error codes.

methods.name: shell_mgmt_register_group
methods.description: Registers the shell management group with the MCUmgr framework.
